title: Record history
description: Saved versions and retained references for this record.
changed: Newer changes have been saved. Refresh history to include them.
rangeContinues: Versions {first}–{last}. More retained references remain to be checked.
duplicateWindow: These references point to versions already shown. Continue to check the remaining references.
complete: All {total} distinct versions have been listed.
reopen: Open history from the record again.
saveFirst: Save this record to start its history.
restoreQuestion: Restore {title} from {date} as a new saved version?
restoreScope: This affects only the open record. Its current version remains in its history, and it stays in its current lab book.
restorePrivate: The restored record and its media will be private until you select them for publication again.
unsaved: Your record has unsaved changes. Close history and save or discard them first.
restored: Record restored as a new saved version. Review its sharing before publishing.
contentRange: Items {first}–{last} of {total} across the compared versions
contentComparison: The current version below and the earlier version show the selected content windows. Use Browse content to inspect further items. The changed-field summary compares the complete versions.
